name: Cross-Asset Carry Tilt - Top-3
description: Ranks the full asset universe by ex-ante carry (expected return from holding with flat prices) and equal-weights only the top 3 highest-carry assets, zeroing all others. Variant between concentrated top-2 and full-universe carry strategies. Bonds (VUTY) typically dominate carry rankings due to high yields; equities provide moderate carry via dividends; precious metals and commodities have negative or near-zero carry. Implements concentrated long-only carry factor.
